name: Prime Sorcerer Vandorallen

abilities.name: Blackspine Curse
abilities.description: Vandorallen targets a player with a debuff that applies a healing absorption effect.

abilities.name: Chain Lightning
abilities.description: All nearby players will take lightning damage when at least one player is standing in one of Vandorallen's Storm Bolt AOEs.

abilities.name: Coruscating Orb
abilities.description: On Hard Mode, Vandorallen will spawn two lightning AOEs that chase the nearest player.

abilities.name: Iron Charge
abilities.description: Vandorallen becomes immune to damage and mounts his horse, knocking down any player in his path. He will also summon Iron Atronach Spiders around the arena. Lucilla will summon an ice shield that will stun any spiders that come into contact.

abilities.name: Lightning Rod Slam
abilities.description: Vandorallen's heavy attack, which spawns lightning AOEs under each player when it finishes.

abilities.name: Racing Flames
abilities.description: Vandorallen will summon flames that spread in a circle around him.

abilities.name: Storm Bolt
abilities.description: Vandorallen spawns a lightning bolt either at the furthest player or around himself, creating a large AOE. Standing in the AOE will chain lightning the group.

dialogue.speaker: Lucilla Caprenia
dialogue.line: Vandorallen, I should have guessed that was your magic.
dialogue.trigger: As you progress through Exiled Redoubt, Lucilla Caprenia will find out that you are being surveilled by Vandorallen

dialogue.speaker: Prime Sorcerer Vandorallen
dialogue.line: You think you can stop me? You never succeeded in the Spire.
dialogue.trigger: As you progress through Exiled Redoubt, Lucilla Caprenia will find out that you are being surveilled by Vandorallen

dialogue.line: <Vandorallen runs away, while Lucilla swings her sword and chases him.>
dialogue.trigger: As you progress through Exiled Redoubt, Lucilla Caprenia will find out that you are being surveilled by Vandorallen

dialogue.speaker: Prime Sorcerer Vandorallen
dialogue.line: The war for your precious Empire killed innocents.
dialogue.trigger: As you progress through Exiled Redoubt, Lucilla Caprenia will find out that you are being surveilled by Vandorallen

dialogue.speaker: Lucilla Caprenia
dialogue.trigger: As you progress through Exiled Redoubt, Lucilla Caprenia will find out that you are being surveilled by Vandorallen

dialogue.line: <Vandorallen throws a green fireball at Lucilla before running away again. She dodges, then continues to chase him.>
dialogue.trigger: As you progress through Exiled Redoubt, Lucilla Caprenia will find out that you are being surveilled by Vandorallen

dialogue.speaker: Lucilla Caprenia
dialogue.line: Why are you even going along with Cato's plan?
dialogue.trigger: As you progress through Exiled Redoubt, Lucilla Caprenia will find out that you are being surveilled by Vandorallen

dialogue.speaker: Prime Sorcerer Vandorallen
dialogue.line: Cato's son died under a diplomatic banner. The alliances must end!
dialogue.trigger: As you progress through Exiled Redoubt, Lucilla Caprenia will find out that you are being surveilled by Vandorallen

dialogue.line: <Vandorallen aims a torrent of fire magic at Lucilla. She blocks his attack with ice magic and her shield. She chases him one final time.>
dialogue.trigger: As you progress through Exiled Redoubt, Lucilla Caprenia will find out that you are being surveilled by Vandorallen

hardmode_info: On Hard Mode, he will also summon Simulacrums.

notes: His journal can be found in Exiled Redoubt, next to a bunk bed near the door to Docent Domitius.
related_quests: Undying Requiem: Help clear out Exiled Redoubt.
Pledge: Exiled Redoubt: Explore Exiled Redoubt and return Undaunted.
summary: Prime Sorcerer Vandorallen is an Imperial battlemage of House Albus who serves as the second boss of Exiled Redoubt. He is the nephew of Cato Albus.
